correctness.rationale: Exact symbolic identities establish the generator on the specified elliptic curve and discriminant for every nonzero parameter. Minimal fiber types are I4,I2,I3,III. Local reduction of the generator and its double determines Shioda contributions 3/4,0,2/3,1/2; with section disjoint from zero the height is 1/12. Shioda–Tate gives geometric rank 1 and the root-lattice determinant 48 plus Néron–Severi unimodularity forces the generator to be primitive and torsion exactly Z/2. A Galois involution acts on the generator by negation if sqrt(-r) is absent, proving all ground-field groups. The attached verifier was executed successfully; finite checks do not prove the infinite-field theorem.
